slice.target: Cargo package.links constraint and supported build-script override path
slice.finding: Cargo documents that a package using package.links must have a build script. Cargo separately supports target.<triple>.<links> configuration that suppresses compilation and execution of that links-associated build script while supplying its link directives and metadata from config. Therefore package.build=false is not the documented suppression mechanism for a links-bearing package; the documented no-run path is a links override with predeclared outputs.
slice.verified_scope: Documentation-only semantics of package.links and target.<triple>.<links> build-script override. No Cargo execution and no specific crate was tested.
slice.not_verified_scope: Whether a particular links-bearing crate can be made correct without its build script; whether all required native/generated artifacts and metadata are knowable in advance; cross-target portability of override configuration; build-dependency pruning; actual compilation; end-to-end richer-mode parity.
slice.scope_guard: Do not generalize the documented override into proof that native discovery, native compilation, code generation, or arbitrary links-bearing crate preparation is eliminable.

exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and SHA-only validate current authority, then run one bounded official-source leaf to determine the portability and completeness limits of Cargo target.<triple>.<links> overrides: whether override matching is target-triple-specific and which build-script outputs cannot be represented predeclared. Keep specific-crate correctness, native/generated artifact creation, build-dependency behavior and actual compilation unresolved; do not run Cargo or start a second leaf.
